title: Device stops under load to protect battery
fullDescription:
Theragun PRO Plus, Elite, and Prime cut power when battery voltage drops too low under load. The OLED shows a battery protection warning.

Charge to at least 50% before high-load deep-tissue sessions.

fixSteps.title: Charge unit
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in charger; PRO Plus supports wireless charging.

fixSteps.title: Resume on higher charge
fixSteps.instruction: Wait for LED to reach >50% before heavy use.

whenToCallPro: If protection triggers even at full charge.

title: Motor overheat protection engaged
fullDescription:
Prolonged stall or high-speed sustained use heats the QX65/QX150 motor. The device throttles speed or shuts off with a thermometer icon.

Rest 15 minutes in open air before restarting.

fixSteps.title: Rest 15 minutes
fixSteps.instruction: Set aside in cool area; no direct sun.

fixSteps.title: Restart at lower speed
fixSteps.instruction: Begin at speed 1-2 to verify operation.

whenToCallPro: If overheating recurs quickly with light use.

title: Motor error displayed on OLED
fullDescription:
A wrench/gear icon or E-MOT code on the Theragun OLED means the brushless motor controller detected a fault (stall, current spike, or sensor error).

Unplug, wait 60 seconds, restart. If fault repeats, Therabody service is required.

fixSteps.title: Check attachment free
fixSteps.instruction: Remove attachment and rotate shaft by hand.

fixSteps.title: Contact Therabody
fixSteps.instruction: File warranty ticket with serial number.

faq.a: 2 years on PRO Plus, 1 year others.

title: App cannot connect to Theragun
shortDescription: Bluetooth pairing issue between phone and device.
fullDescription:
Therabody app pairs via Bluetooth. Pairing fails if device is off, phone location permission disabled, or another phone already connected.

Hold power + settings for 10 seconds to reset Bluetooth on the device.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: In Therabody app, add device fresh.

title: PRO rotating arm won't pivot
shortDescription: Debris or damaged hinge on rotating arm.
fullDescription:
The Theragun PRO Plus multi-grip arm pivots through four angles. If stuck, check for dust/debris at the hinge or a dropped/damaged pin.

Clean gently and avoid forcing against detent clicks.

fixSteps.title: Blow out hinge
fixSteps.instruction: Use canned air on pivot joints.

fixSteps.title: Rotate through clicks
fixSteps.instruction: Gently rotate to each detent; do not force.

fixSteps.title: Service if damaged
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Therabody if pin is bent.

title: Attachment head keeps detaching
shortDescription: Worn attachment collar or wrong seating.
fullDescription:
Theragun attachments snap onto a shaft with a spring-loaded ball detent. If attachments fall off mid-use, inspect the rubber collar and ball detent for wear.

Replace worn attachments — the rubber cups compress over time.

fixSteps.title: Push firmly
fixSteps.instruction: Press attachment on shaft until click.

fixSteps.title: Inspect collar
fixSteps.instruction: Check rubber ring for cracks or stretching.

faq.a: Mostly yes across current Theragun line.

title: Theragun fails to charge
fullDescription:
The Theragun uses a barrel connector (Prime/Elite) or wireless Qi pad (PRO Plus). Check connector for bent pin and confirm charger LED is lit.

For PRO Plus wireless, ensure perfect centering on Qi pad.

fixSteps.title: Inspect jack
fixSteps.instruction: Look into the charge port for bent pins with flashlight.

fixSteps.title: Verify charger
fixSteps.instruction: Swap for known-good charger if available.

fixSteps.title: Try slow charge
fixSteps.instruction: Leave on charger 4 hours to wake battery.

whenToCallPro: Bent pin or dead after extended charge.

faq.a: Only newer models; older use barrel jack.

title: Speed adjustment buttons not working
shortDescription: Capacitive button layer glitched or locked by app.
fullDescription:
Elite and PRO Plus use capacitive speed buttons next to the OLED. Unresponsiveness can be a firmware lockup (from an interrupted routine) or oily fingers interfering.

Wipe the OLED area and power-cycle.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power 10 seconds to force off, then restart.

whenToCallPro: If buttons still unresponsive after firmware update.
videoSearchQuery: Theragun speed button not working fix

faq.q: Can I operate via app only?

title: Prime shows no Bluetooth icon
shortDescription: Some Prime units lack Bluetooth — not a fault.
fullDescription:
Theragun Prime earlier revisions did not include Bluetooth; only Elite/PRO/PRO Plus support app connection. Check product generation.

No action needed — feature is absent by design.

title: Handle rattles or vibrates excessively
shortDescription: Internal screws loose or attachment misaligned.
fullDescription:
Normal Theragun vibration is firm but contained. If the handle rattles, internal screws may have loosened from drops. Swap attachments to isolate.

Persistent rattle after swap requires service.

fixSteps.title: Swap attachment
fixSteps.instruction: Try another attachment to confirm source.

fixSteps.title: Test at all speeds
fixSteps.instruction: Run through each speed to identify resonance.

fixSteps.title: Contact support
fixSteps.instruction: If rattle remains, request warranty inspection.
